hypothesis: Conditional edit-response knowledge may change a subsequent update direction, scope or coordination; Keep is valid when no applicable effect exists. Execution must test the actual behavior on the source failure before any generalization claim.

screen_rule: One previously unused Train instance per simple placement, cooling and two-object family: smallest unused ID in each family. Metadata selection only.
